SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. S. B. REGISTRY
D 4850
115123

May 6, 3.

Sir,

I have to acknowledge receipt of your letter of
April 28 addressed to Mr. T.P. Givens on the subject
of an address found by the Berlin Police during the
examination of a Dane, Henry Bisberg, and to inform you
that as a result of enquiries it has been ascertained
that P.J. Nien P.P. refers to one Nien Wen Yuen (嚴文元)
age 39, native of Laungshan, Chekiang, residing with his
family at No.1267 Tatung Road, at which address he has
lived for the past five years. Nien Wen Yuen (嚴文元)
owns and manages, together with one Koo (顧) a small
tooth brush factory, which was situated at No.1267 Tatung
Road until about 6 months ago when it was removed to 67
Tien Pau Lee (天寶里) Alleyway off Haining Road, &
Nien (嚴) is also engaged in the sale of motor cars.

Attempts made to purchase narcotics at No.1267
Tatung Road have been unsuccessful, and discreet enquiry
indicate that members of the household are not addicted to
opium or its substitutes.

I am, Sir,

Your obedient servant,

(Sd) K. M. Bourne.
Deputy Commissioner (Crime).

J. Barton, Esquire,
H.B.M. Consulate-General,
Shanghai.

刑事与特别科登记处
D 4850

1933年5月6日。

先生：

谨此确认收到阁下于4月28日致 T.P. Givens 先生的信函，该函涉及柏林警方在审讯一名丹麦人 Henry Bisberg 时发现的一个地址一事。现告知阁下，经查询查明，“P.J. Nien P.P.” 系指严文元（Nien Wen Yuen），39岁，浙江龙山人，与其家人居住于大同路1267号，在该地址已居住五年。严文元与一名顾姓人士（Koo）共同拥有并经营一家小型牙刷厂，该厂原址位于大同路1267号，约六个月前迁至海宁路天寶里67号；此外，严文元还从事汽车销售业务。

试图在大同路1267号购买麻醉品的尝试均未成功，且谨慎的调查表明，该住户成员并未吸食鸦片或其替代品。

此致，

阁下恭顺的仆人，

（签名）K. M. Bourne.
副总监（刑事）。

J. Barton 先生，
英国驻上海总领事馆，
上海。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No. ________
Headquarters Narcotic Section C.I. Station,
REPORT
Date May 6, 19 33.

Subject (in full) 1267 Tatung Road

Made by D.I. Papp    Forwarded by Supt. Quayle

T.J. Nien P.P. refers to one Nien Wen Yuen (嚴文元)
39, native of Laungshan, Chekiang, who resides with his family
at 1267 Tatung Road - the address given in the attached letter of
April 25, 1933. Nien Wen Yuen has been residing at the above
address, which is a small dwelling house located in the Sz Wen
Lee alleyway, for the past 5 years. Nien owns and manages to-
gether with one Koo (顧) a small tooth powder factory and is
also engaged in the sale of motor cars. The tooth factory is
now located at Tien Pau Lee (天寶里) alleyway off Haining Road,
Chapei, whereto it was removed from No; 1245 Taku Road about 6
months ago.

Attempts made with a view to purchasing narcotics at
the above address have been unsuccessful. C.D.S. 76 visited the
above address on two occasions and ascertained that the members
of the household are not addicted to opium or its substitutes.

D. I. Papp
D. I.

D.C. (Crime)

总部麻醉品科 C.I. 站，
报告
日期 1933年5月6日。

主题（全称） 大同路1267号

由 D.I. Papp 制作    由 Supt. Quayle 转呈

“T.J. Nien P.P.” 系指严文元（Nien Wen Yuen），39岁，浙江龙山人，与其家人居住于大同路1267号——即附上的1933年4月25日信函中提供的地址。严文元在过去五年中一直居住在上述地址，该处是位于斯文里（Sz Wen Lee）巷弄内的一所小住宅。严文元与一名顾姓人士（Koo）共同拥有并经营一家小型牙粉厂，并从事汽车销售业务。该牙刷厂目前位于闸北海宁路天寶里巷弄，约六个月前从大沽路1245号迁至此处。

试图在上述地址购买麻醉品的尝试均未成功。C.D.S. 76 曾两次访问上述地址，并查明该住户成员并未吸食鸦片或其替代品。

D. I. Papp
督察

副总监（刑事）

25th April 1933.

My dear Givens,

During the examination of a Dane, HENRY
BISJBERG, with regard to a charge of opium smuggling
which could not be substantiated, the Berlin Police
found the following address:

T.J.Nien P.P.
1267 Tatung Road,
Shanghai

I send the above in case this address may be connected
with the smuggling of narcotics.

Yours sincerely,
〔签名〕

T.P.Givens, Esq.,
Special Branch,
S.M.P.

1933年4月25日。

亲爱的 Givens：

在审讯一名丹麦人 HENRY BISJBERG 期间，因其涉嫌鸦片走私的指控无法证实，柏林警方发现了以下地址：

T.J.Nien P.P.
上海大同路1267号

我发送上述信息，以防该地址可能与麻醉品走私有关。

此致，
〔签名〕

T.P.Givens 先生，
特别科，
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
